description: The chart illustrates two sets of bar values for four methods, showing Accuracy (%) on the left side and Token Count on the right side. The category axis is horizontal with two unlabeled groups of four bars each (the left group corresponds to Accuracy and the right group corresponds to Token Count), and the bars within each group appear in the same left-to-right order as the legend: a red method (label not shown in the visible legend area), CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green). The left vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100, with tick marks at 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, and 100; the right vertical axis is labeled “Token Count” with a linear scale from 0 to 800 with ticks every 100. In the Accuracy group, the red bar is labeled 91.19, the orange CoD bar is 80.89, the light-blue CCoT bar is 88.50, and the green CoUT bar is 88.40. In the Token Count group, the red bar is labeled 676.85, the orange CoD bar is 534.24, the light-blue CCoT bar is 445.91, and the green CoUT bar is 354.46. Each bar has a numeric value annotation above it, there is no stacking (single bars per method), and the bars are not shown as sorted by magnitude; no bars appear specially emphasized beyond their distinct colors and value labels.
